documented_probe: C-a4cb7c45 (emit plan records in the required schema): reference floor is hard and this covering task exercises it at hard — the client must page a clamped paginated API, derive a per-tier shape object, and deserialize-exactly one record per request; wrong keys or structure are rejected by the service and a duplicate submission permanently fails the session.
notes: HTTP-services covering task for C-a4cb7c45 (flint-ember is the reference). Hard via: paginated retrieval with a server-side limit clamp, a three-part shape derivation with per-tier bases and a gpu conditional plus disk ceiling, strict record schema (exact keys id/batch/shape, shape keys exact, integer types), and a permanent duplicate-plan failure state. Hidden sessions vary portfolio size (1..95), gpu presence forms, and storage boundaries.
